title: NYC Taxi Demand Forecasting & Optimization
summary: An applied forecasting project exploring how recorded taxi pickups can support fleet planning. I use DuckDB and pandas to validate trip records, combine daily counts with weather data, and compare simple forecasts using chronological evaluation.
finding: In an April experiment, daily updates reduced forecast bias but increased mean absolute error by 15.2% compared with a fixed monthly forecast. More frequent updates did not automatically improve accuracy.
completed: Daily data validation, weather integration, weekday-mean baselines, daily walk-forward evaluation, and five metric unit tests.
next: Evaluate longer rolling windows and reserve a later unseen period for final testing. Fleet assignment optimization is planned.
